description: Failure memory from v3 random BO for deploy-time reject/penalise filters
filter_recipe: reject candidate near failure exemplar k/AB patterns; penalise high form_segment_coverage_pct when line_detection_confidence_K is low

per_ring_rules.filter_recipe: reject if layout_k_center_norm in [reject_k_center_norm_lo, reject_k_center_norm_hi] or failure_tags match bad_k_shift; penalise if form_segment_coverage_pct >= penalise_coverage_min AND line_detection_confidence_K <= penalise_k_confidence_max (good form does not guarantee good mIoU when K is wrong)
